summary: Follow a guided loss of grid power at four fictional nuclear units, then inspect the evidence and restore their external supply.
about: The guide finds Unit 1, opens its live display and offers an editable Assistant prompt. When the fault occurs at two simulation minutes, inspect the plant and grid response and restore offsite power. Choose Explore for direct control. It shows Leitbild connecting plant, grid and guidance based on observations.

previews.alt: Unit 1’s live plant display with the guide open and the bottom Alarms and Guide controls.

summary: Coordinate nuclear maintenance across assets, crews, inspection bookings and work-control gates.
about: Coordinate sixteen tasks on three cooling-train assets, keeping both B pumps outside the work scope. Compare existing crews with a specialist contractor, inspect finish-driving handoffs and crew usage, and preview an estimate change. Ask the Assistant about a deadline, inspect matching World equipment, or calculate heat transport. It shows Leitbild connecting plant observations with checked schedules and reproducible calculations using declared work estimates, qualifications, planned gates and costs.

previews.alt: Cooling-train maintenance with dated crew alternatives, an interactive schedule and selected task handoffs.

summary: Inspect a weakness in northern Norway’s grid, change one independent copy and compare both futures with a paced guide.
about: Inspect the northern grid with the guide and pause the clock to prepare the comparison. Create an independent copy, make the preventive change in one simulation, then advance both to the same time and compare their actual state. Choose Explore to investigate freely. It shows Leitbild supporting guided what-if comparisons while preserving the original.

previews.alt: Northern grid map with Grid operations and a guide preparing an independent-copy comparison.

summary: Send ambulances, patrol cars and fire engines to a steady stream of fictional calls in Halden, by touch or with a mouse.
about: Tap or click a waiting call, then Dispatch to send its suggested unit; or tap a unit, then a highlighted target on the map. Calls keep coming for 30 minutes, some at the same moment, and the Dispatch panel lists every call, unit and site. It shows Leitbild configuring units, calls and their words through Einsatz, its general dispatch engine.

previews.alt: Halden, paused: ambulance A2 selected in the Dispatch panel; the calls and sites it can go to are tagged with travel times, the rest faded.
